faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 16 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Essential: Bachelor's degree in Agriculture from a recognized university. Desirable: work experience in germplasm collection/field survey and laboratory work; communication and writing skills with competency in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 18-11-2026 at 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post is temporary in nature for a period of 5 months. Terms and conditions of appointment guided by the rules and regulations of Central Agricultural University (Imphal)/College of Agriculture-Kyrdemkulai/funding agency.

faq.answer: College of Agriculture, Kyrdemkulai, Ri-Bhoi, Meghalaya.
